coreConfigPage.title: M04.1 · Core lifecycle & replacement alert configuration
coreConfigPage.description: The single source of truth the device uses to count core lifespan and the app uses to show replacement alerts.
coreConfigPage.modelSourceNote: Models come from product-line data; a model only defines core positions and compatible SKUs, never lifespan.
coreConfigPage.empty: This model has no core positions yet.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.batchAlreadyRecalled: This batch has already been recalled.

coreLifecycle.title: Core lifecycle configuration
coreLifecycle.precedenceNote: Precedence: core SKU → model core position → per-device TDS factor → campaign. Lifespan or factor changes apply only to consumption from the time of the edit; history is not recalculated.
coreLifecycle.skuSourceNote: The core SKU catalog comes from product-line data; the portal only configures lifespan, thresholds and factors.
coreLifecycle.defaultNotCompatible: Default SKU must be one of the compatible SKUs.
